reconstructed_captions.30: The gunner takes the ammunition belt out of the box.
reconstructed_captions.31: The gunner begins feeding the ammunition belt into the machine gun's feed tray.
reconstructed_captions.32: A close-up shows the gunner's hands guiding the ammunition belt into the weapon.
reconstructed_captions.33: The gunner carefully aligns the first round of the belt on the feed tray.
reconstructed_captions.34: The ammunition belt is laid across the open feed tray.
reconstructed_captions.35: With the belt in place, the gunner prepares to close the feed cover.
reconstructed_captions.36: The gunner pushes the feed cover down to secure the ammunition belt.
reconstructed_captions.37: The gunner firmly snaps the feed cover shut, locking it into place.
reconstructed_captions.38: A shot shows the ammunition belt properly seated inside the machine gun.
reconstructed_captions.39: The gunner reaches for the charging handle on the side of the machine gun.
reconstructed_captions.40: The gunner pulls the charging handle all the way back to chamber the first round.
reconstructed_captions.41: The gunner releases the charging handle, allowing it to slide forward.
reconstructed_captions.42: A close-up shows the charging handle returning to its forward position.
reconstructed_captions.43: The machine gun is now fully reloaded and ready to fire.
reconstructed_captions.44: The assisting soldier steps away as the gunner takes position.
reconstructed_captions.45: The gunner grips the handles of the machine gun, assuming a firing stance.
reconstructed_captions.46: The gunner looks over the water, scanning for a target.
reconstructed_captions.47: The gunner adjusts their aim while looking through the weapon's sights.
